title: CAN Intel Signal Extraction Across Byte Boundaries
description:
In automotive CAN bus networking, signals defined by DBC files frequently straddle byte boundaries in little-endian (Intel) format.

### Requirements:
Implement `can_extract_intel_signal16(payload, start_bit, bit_len)` by reading consecutive bytes into a sliding window, shifting right by `start_bit % 8`, and masking with `(1 << bit_len) - 1`.
hint: Forming a 32-bit little-endian window from `payload[byte_idx]` and `payload[byte_idx + 1]` allows extracting any boundary-spanning signal in a single shift and mask.
